prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE new collectible character-card illustration, portrait 9:16, single continuous full-bleed painting, highest available native resolution. Character: 管理员 from Arknights: Endfield, for the unofficial fan game Talos / 塔卫牌局.
Input image 1 is the canonical APPEARANCE reference. Input image 2 is the approved existing normal card, for identity and clothing continuity ONLY. Create a genuinely NEW scene, pose, expression and camera arrangement; do not copy either layout. Preserve hairstyle, face shape, species features, outfit layers, color identifiers, accessories and canonical equipment. Do not invent a different costume, weapon or extra animal ears.
Quality tier: fine. Style: Refined luminous gouache and watercolor illustration with fine colored-pencil accents, sophisticated color harmony, delicate foliage and fabric textures, clear foreground-middle-distance layers and generous negative space. Richer environmental storytelling and painterly finish than the normal portrait cards. Not a flat cel-shaded bust and not dark oil-painted cinematic spectacle.
Composition and action: a complete figure in a spacious asymmetrical environment, eye-level medium-long view; walking along a gently curving path, reaching naturally toward a small environmental detail.
Scene and palette: a pale turquoise and warm coral field-station garden after rain, layered grasses, wet stone, a restrained technological structure and distant hills. This is an original fan-art moment, not an assertion of an official story event. 
Facial acting: absorbed curiosity and gentle wonder; clear sideward gaze, slightly lifted brow and a restrained open or closed smile suited to the character. Character-specific personality reference: restrained curiosity conveyed by a small head tilt and relaxed shoulders; preserve all canonical face coverings. Coordinate eyebrows, eyelids, pupils, cheeks and mouth so the expression is alive and individual. Do not paste the same smile on every card. Preserve the opaque black angular visor over the eyes exactly; do not invent visible eyes. Facial acting must use the visible mouth, head angle and shoulders. Keep the same canonical gender presentation.
Natural anatomy and hands, clean readable silhouette, harmonious proportions, detailed face with the sharpest local focus. Tasteful nonsexual framing. No lettering, symbols masquerading as text, signature, watermark, logo, card border or UI. Do not print rarity or resolution. This image will be separately super-resolved to 2160x3840, with original size preserved in metadata.
